capabilities.description: Ingests document:harbourline_boq.xlsx as the priced BOQ source of record and registers the contract terms from document:harbourline_contract.pdf (Accepted Contract Amount, Time for Completion of 730 days, retention, performance security) as governed baseline values that every other capability reads.

Builds interim payment certificates against BOQ line items (P1-P5, E1-E5), applies the 5% retention per Clause 14.3 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf, records the 50% release at Taking-Over and 50% at end of the 365-day Defects Notification Period, and tracks certification status through approval

Computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay against the 730-day Time for Completion (Clause 8.2) and enforces the 10% cap (Clause 8.7) of document:harbourline_contract.pdf, with an auditable event trail for each assessed day.

Holds Inspection and Test Plan records against BOQ work sections (Preliminaries, Earthworks), with hold points, sign-offs, and evidence attachments so each priced item can be released for payment only when its ITP is closed out.

Maintains the project document register of contract-controlled documents including document:harbourline_contract.pdf and document:harbourline_boq.xlsx, plus their revisions, with content hashing and version history so every claim cites a verifiable source.
Pulls the uploaded contract and BOQ from the project's shared drive into the register, keeping the register authoritative when newer revisions are uploaded.

Single dashboard showing live position on accepted contract amount, certified-to-date vs BOQ, retention held, delay-damage exposure against the cap, open ITP hold points, and register document status for the contract administrator.
